description: List the newest redacted LLM-traffic records captured from the BSH host's observe hooks. Host-mediated traffic only. Each row carries metadata and the masked request/response headers; bodies are read one exchange at a time with the `exchange` tool, and the newest 12 exchanges keep them.

limit.description: How many records to return, newest first (1-100, default 20).

point.description: Only records from this hook point.
